mapper.sql: r.id, r.order_id, r.order_no, r.order_title, r.engineer_id applicant_id, r.engineer_name applicant_name, r.original_deadline, r.requested_deadline, r.request_reason reason, r.status request_status, r.decided_by approver_id, r.decided_by_name approver_name, r.decision_reason approval_comment, r.decided_at approved_at, r.create_time, r.update_time
mapper.insert: insert into wo_delay_request (order_id, order_no, order_title, engineer_id, engineer_name, original_deadline, requested_deadline, request_reason, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderTitle}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{originalDeadline}, #{requestedDeadline}, #{reason}, #{requestStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select from wo_delay_request r where r.id = #{id}
select from wo_delay_request r where r.id = #{id} for update
select from wo_delay_request r where r.order_id = #{orderId} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc limit 1
select from wo_delay_request r where r.order_id = #{orderId} and r.status = 'PENDING' order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update wo_delay_request set status = #{requestStatus}, decided_by = #{approverId}, decided_by_name = #{approverName}, decision_reason = #{approvalComment}, decided_at = #{approvedAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'

update wo_delay_request set status = 'CANCELLED', decided_by = #{operatorId}, decided_by_name = #{operatorName}, decision_reason = #{reason}, decided_at = #{actionTime}, update_time = #{actionTime} where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select id from wo_attachment where biz_ref_id = #{requestId} and order_id is not null and del_flag = '0' order by create_time, id
